decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model line central to the firm's announced push toward automated precast production, with substantial engineering invested and visible web presence, management will attribute any slow uptake to the construction downturn and persist with it, though the earlier robot withdrawals show some willingness to cut.

Production analysis software is close to the core offering, cheap to maintain, and supports the firm's publicly stated digital and automation direction, so management will keep it and treat weak early results as temporary.
